The Dominican Republic is scheduled to compete at the 2028 Summer Olympics in Los Angeles from 14 July to 30 July 2028. It will be the nation's seventeenth consecutive appearance at the Summer Olympics.

Baseball
The Dominican Republic national baseball team qualified for the Olympics by advancing to the semifinal match and securing an outright berth as the highest-ranked squad from American, excluding the host nation United States, at the  2026 World Baseball Classic in Miami.
